description.zh: 介紹電子、半導體、績體電路及數位技術的基本原理、及其應用。期使工業設計學生能具備21世紀微電子e世代產品新科技之基本知識。
description.en: A general introduce to the principle of Electronic technology, Semi-conductor, Integrated circuits, Digital technology, and their industrial applications. In order to equip design students with the basic knowledge of Micro-electronic with in the new Era.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討如何整合科技於文化創意產業，透過案例教學，幫助學生結合有效率的資訊科技工具於人文藝術，以發展文化創意產業，並創造高附加價值的效益。當今產、官、學、研都強調跨域整合的重要性，文創與互動科技的結合，能為文化創意作加值，並注入新生命、新體驗，因此，文創遇到科技後，所激盪出的火花與創意，已逐漸受到產、學界的青睞。本課程將探討文化創意的發展脈絡、文創的底蘊與其應用面、互動科技的應用，透過文獻研讀、案例分析等方式，瞭解國外最新研究與趨勢，討論文創與科技的創新應用可行性，引領文化創意產業轉型，規劃未來文創與科技整合的新契機。
description.en: The course intends to explore about how to integrate the technology into the cultural and creative Industries. Through case study, it will help students to combine efficient information technology tools in the field of arts and humanities, and also facilitate the development of cultural and creative industries, and create high value-added benefits for these industries. Today's industry, government, academia, research has emphasized the importance of cross-discipline consolidation. It means that cultural creation and interactive technology combined with value-added as a bonus for the cultural creation, and implant new life, new experiences. Therefore, when the cultural creation encounter technology, which bring out the spark and creativity, has gradually been favored both with industry and academia. This course will explore the cultural creative context, cultural inside information and its application, the interactive technology application by using the method of literature review, cas

name.en: Special Integration Topics on Technology in Cultural and Creative Industry

description.zh: 本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: This course is a joint seminar for all the doctoral students, which will be progressed by paper presentation of special topics on design issues, giving lectures, and group meeting.

notes: ◎博二選課，請依分組&共同討論上課時間

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車引擎實習，包含汽油及柴油引擎拆裝，引擎實驗，引擎量測與調整，點火、燃油、冷卻及潤滑系統之檢測及故障排除，定期調諧保養及引擎排氣檢測。
description.en: Automobile Engine Service Shop Practice ,Gasoline & Diesel Engine Assembly, Engine Test, Engine Tune-up and Repair, Trouble-shooting and Instrument Adjustment on: Ignition System, Fuel System, Cooling System, Lubrication System, and Starting System, Routine Engine Tune-Up and Engine Exhaust Emission Check .

notes: 限制車輛系選修且人數15人上限，與車輛三、四合開

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en: This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

interdisciplinary: 智慧鐵道微學程
notes: 綜一演講廳，車輛三、四合開

description.zh: 本課程著重於中英文口頭報告能力之培養，在模擬發表過程中，培養學生使用正確的表達用法，並建立適當之應對方式。
description.en: This course offers opportunities for students to develop their oral presentation skills in both Chinese and English languages via simulated presentations in class. Students will learn how to present their papers precisely and how to engage a conversation properly.

description.zh: 線性空間分析，狀態方程式及響應，可控制性及可觀測性，穩定性分析，狀態回授及估測，控制器設計及應用，觀測器設計及應用，非線性系統，時變系統，控制理論的應用
description.en: Linear space Analysis, State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability, Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Control theory

notes: 車輛所和能源車輛外生班合開

description.zh: 本課程主要包含四部份，分別為基本有限差分法、流體力學與熱傳方程式的有限差分法應用、有限體積法、格點產生法。
description.en: This course comprises four parts. Part one is fundamentals of finite-difference methods. Part 2 is the application of finite-difference methods to the equations of fluid mechanics and heat transfer. Part 3 is finite-volume method. Part 4 is grid generation.

notes: 車輛所和能源車輛外生班合開

description.zh: 本課程所為研究所課程，內容包括主動煞車控制系統介紹，將針對ABS, TCS, ESP 及 SBC 煞車系統原理介紹，煞車系統及控制器之數學模式及設計等，應用實例介紹。
description.en: This course is designed mainly for senior/graduate students. The objective of this course is to introduce active braking control system, such as ABS, TCS, ESP and SBC background. The mathematical model of the system and its applications for the controller design of braking system are also included.

notes: 車輛所、機電博班(含外生班)和能源車輛外生班合開

description.zh: 本課程從基礎聲學開始介紹電聲元件的原理，進而講授電聲元件揚聲器及麥克風、電聲元件的類比電路分析法、音箱設計、電聲元件的量測方法以及音箱設計軟體的應用，帶引學生進入電聲學的領域。
description.en: This course first introduces principles of electro-acoustic transducers from fundamental acoustics. Then topics in the lectures including introduction of moving-coil loudspeaker and microphone, analog circuits analysis method for electro- acoustic transducers , loudspeaker enclosure design, measurement test of electro-acoustic transducers and the application of loudspeaker enclosure design software. The aim of this course is to bring students into the field of Electro-Acoustics.

description.zh: 設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：1.描述設計方法的演變2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en: Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.Upon completing this course, you will be able to:1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

notes: 工設四三與日碩合開，人數上限7

description.zh: 本課程為沿續統計學課程，探討論文寫作所需統計分析理論與方法。課程內容含: 一因子與二因子變異數分析、實驗設計、多元迴歸分析、因素分析、集群分析、區別分析與結構方程式等。1. Introduction to SPSS2. Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)3. Experimental Design4. Nonparametric Test5. Multiple Regression6. Factor Analysis7. Cluster Analysis8. Discriminant Analysis9. Structural Equation Model (SEM)
description.en: This course focuses on application of statistical principles and methods. Course including ANOVA, Experimental Design, Nonparametric Test, Multiple Regression, Factor Analysis, Cluster Analysis, Discriminant Analysis and Structural Equation Model (SEM).

description.zh: 21世紀的工業設計師已不能再靜待市場研究及產品企劃人員提供產品設計規範，而應以使用者代言人、及企業產品開發整合者身分，主動參與產品策略與企劃，並以視覺化技術協助相關人員作橫向溝通。因此，「產品創新設計策略與企劃」課程主要目標在教導學生以「前瞻性的視野」，透過創新設計的步驟與方法，策劃出符合企業技術及經營體質，並且能滿足市場及使用者使用情況需求的產品。本課程將以理論、方法、案例研討及個案研究方式進行。
description.en: The function of industrial design in the 21st century, will no longer waiting for the product definition from the marketing and product planning, It will become a integrator and visualizer during the product innovation strategic phase, and concerning to the user's needs.Product Innovation Strategy will guide the enterprise looking beyond their current operation to match their technologies and the distinct competencies with emerging the user and the market needs.The contents of this topic will include theory, methodology, and practical case study.

interdisciplinary:
創新與創業學程
創業家精神微學程
notes: 工設三四上限10/日碩博上限20/職碩上限12；一教1F

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

name.zh: 進階整合設計研究與實務專題(一)
name.en: Advanced integrated design research and practice project

description.zh: 產品設計專案包含研究與設計。設計專案透過工業設計的理論、方法及程序，以研究的手段形成設計決策，或以實證的方式將研究成果應用於設計實務。設計專案之設計成果必須建立在相關的研究基礎上。
description.en: This course is directed toward an approved product design project withresearch and design completed under supervision of the director. Theory andpractice in research and development dealing with the design project isreviewed in the study. Projects must represent a meaningful contribution tothe field of design base on supportive research.

notes: *日職創新所與設計博合開；人數上限8

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹研究電腦整合設計與製造之軟體，並藉實例演練，以達熟悉研究電腦整合設計與製造之操作與功能。
description.en: To introduce and study the software of computer integrated design and manufacturing. By the project practice, to be adept at the operation and function of computer integrated design and manufacturing.

name.zh: 電腦整合設計與製造研究
name.en: Study of Computer Integrated Design and Manufacturing

description.zh: 本課程旨在以個別與小組合作模式，訓練學生通曉設計開發流程，以執行設計專案。藉由實務案例的運作，及兼顧產業與組織之需求，以體現產業與社會文化面的問題與解決對策。本課程又以培育學生具備專業設計師之設計企劃提案與概念發想能力，以及學生使用設計工具之能力。
description.en: The goal of Advanced Product Design (II) is to train, under supervision, students in strategic areas of the product development process. In these projects, the students work alone or in groups. The projects are usually based on problems defined within different branches of industry and social sectors. Project work is usually done under realistic conditions, in collaboration with different industrial companies or public institutions. Students can contribute to this reality by developing sensible and usable products and systems which include qualities that speak to the heart and mind of people. We educate students as designers to have an open mind on both conceptual ideas and detailed realistic design solutions in order to develop higher quality products. Another important focus area of this course is to improve the students' capabilities in the use of modern design tools.

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用，及結論。
description.en: This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and techniques required in Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI). The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction to precision metrology and machine vision, the measurement principles and methods used in the 2D AOI, the measurement principles and techniques used in the 3D AOI, image processing and artificial intelligence methods used in automatic inspection, intelligent measurement systems, AOI system integration and conclusion.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。半導體元件、整流電路、電晶體和電路、運算放大器、線性積體電路、邏輯元件、數位電路、數位積體電路、微處理器、放大器等。
description.en: Semiconduction Device, Rectifier circuit, Transistor Circuit, Operational Amplifier, Linear Integrated Circuit, logic Device, Digital Circuit, Digital Integrated Circuit, Micro Processor, Amplifier, etc.

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
機電_第二專長【機械系_精密製造】

description.zh: 工程分析概論，有限元素模型建立，進階模組技巧，實體模型的建立，一維元素分析，二維元素分析，三維元素分析，進階範例。
description.en: Introduction to Engineering Analysis, Finite Element Model Constructing, Advanced Techniques of Module, Solid modelsConstructing, One-dimensional Analysis, Two-dimensional Analysis, Three-dimensional Analysis, Advanced Examples.

name.zh: 電腦輔助工程分析及實習
name.en: Computer Aided Engineering Analysis and Lab.

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【機械系_機械設計】

description.zh: 本課程以機械製造結合工業4.0技術為主，包括近代製造技術概論、E化製造、物聯網基本介紹、巨量資料於製程優化的應用、智慧型演算之原理與應用、機器視覺檢測應用、彈性製造系統、網宇實體系統、智能化工廠應用實例、應用APP撰寫等，增進學生對現代製造技術內容之理解、內化、與判斷應用能力，並加強工業4.0相關最新科技之介紹與應用，以期培養對應用聯網技術、大數據、雲端運算、及人工智慧於製造相關課題有技術與能力之工程師。
description.en: This course is based on integration of mechanical manufacturing and industry 4.0, which is made of the modern manufacturing, the computational manufacturing,the internet of things, the optimization of manufacturing using big data, the intelligent calculation, machine vision measurement, flexible manufacturing, CPS system, smart factory, APP, etc.. This course can improve student’s knowledge of modern manufacturing, judgment, and industry 4.0, which will further create engineers with networking technology, big data, cloud calculation, and artificial intelligence in manufacturing.

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

name.en: The theory and practice of 3D Printing

description.zh: 課程內容包括：課程分為三部分，第一、接合技術之基礎：材料表面結構和接合力學。第二、介紹一般工程用接合技術：機械接合、銲接、銲接冶金、軟硬銲、金屬-陶瓷接合、擴散鍵結、和膠合。第三、接合應用：真空系統和微電子接合和密封結構介紹。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first three chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of joining, including: Introduction, Surface science, and The mechanics of joining. The next six chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the joining and assembly of the components of an engineering system, including: Mechanical bonding, Welding, Welding Metallurgy, Soldering & Brazing, Metal-Ceramic Joints & Diffusion Bonding, Adhesives, and Structural Adhesives. The last two chapters take two areas of special interest, vacuum system and microelectronics, and survey the range of resolutions to joining problems which have been developed for these specific application.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。變分微積分與最佳化之關係及其在工程最佳化上之應用、端點條件、不連續最佳化程序、無限制及有限制條件最佳化問題、直接法及實際最佳化設計應用等。
description.en: Introduction of Variational Calculus and its Application in the Engineering Optimal Design, Constrained/Unconstrained Optimal Design Problems, Discrete Optimal Control and Mathematical Programming, Practical Examples of Optimum Design.

interdisciplinary: 機電_第二專長【機械系_機械設計】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。半導體材料、二極體、電晶體的原理、邏輯IC、記憶體IC。如物理沈積(PVD)、化學沈積(CVD)、高溫處理、微影、蝕刻及其相關設備介紹、廠物、維修、管理及工安等。IC封裝及測試。
description.en: Introduction to semiconductor material, diode, transistor, logic IC and memory IC, etc. description of the operation principles technology and related facilities about semiconductor fabrication processes, such as Physicalvapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), doping , oxidation , heat process, lithography , and etching etc., discussion of utilities, maintenance, management and industrial safety in the factory. Discussion of IC packaging and testing.

interdisciplinary: 半導體設備微學程

description.zh: 人工智慧、5G行動通訊、雲端運算、區塊鏈、大數據、物聯網、無線區域網路、汽車電子、近場通訊、行動支付、智慧生活等，科技發展日新月異，便利你我的生活，但也助長了新的犯罪手段，專注新興科技的同時，資訊安全更要與時俱進。本課程將著重於資訊安全的基礎知識，以及對於現今通用的各種資訊安全觀念、技術、管理與應用給予整體性的認識，未來可進一步修習相關進階課程。
description.en: The rapid development of science and technology facilitates your life and mine, such as artificial intelligence, 5G mobile communication, cloud computing, blockchain, big data, Internet of Things, wireless local area network, vehicle electronics, near field communication, mobile payment, smart life, etc., but it also encourages new criminal methods. While focusing on emerging technologies, information security must move with the times. This course will focus on the basic knowledge of information security, giving whole understanding of various information security concepts, technologies, management and applications in common use today. In the future, students can further study related advanced courses.

notes: ◎一般教室(40人)，智動科限20人，與機械二甲乙合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意（1） 瞬時平面運動學：Hartman構圖法,反曲點元，切線圓，Euer- Savary方程式，Bobillier構圖法，四連桿組耦桿之直線包絡線方程式，Higher Curvature（2） 平面連桿機構分析：Freudenstein方程式，速度及加速度，傳遞角與機械利益，多迴路連桿組分析（3） 其它機構分析：凸輪，齒輪組，非圓形齒輪
description.en: （1） Instantaneous Plane Kinematics:Hartman's construction, Inflection circle ,Tangential circle ,Euler -Savary Equation ,Bobillier's construction, Higher curvature（2） Analysis of plane Linkage:Freudenstein Equation, Velocity and Acceleration, Transmission Angle and Mechanical Advantage, Multiple-Loop linkage（3） Analysis of Cams, Gear Trains, Non-Circular Gears.

notes: ◎/機電所、製科所、機械自動外生班和機電博班合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道號誌系統的內涵。號誌系統是列車運行的控制系統。其功用必需兼顧整個鐵道運輸系統的「安全」、「迅速」、與「經濟」。由於號誌系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與控制等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道號誌系統專家、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊與自動控制等三部分提出號誌系統規劃與評估報告，並邀請鐵道號誌系統專家擔任評審。
description.en: This course is one of the optional courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The goal of this course is, via both in-class lecturing and field-trip visiting, to have participant students realize the contents of Railway Signal System. The signal system is the control system of train operation. To give consideration to safety, rapidness and economy of entire railway transportation system, this system will be required. Since the signal system is the technology including management, communication and automatic control, this course is a joint-lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors for the participant students include experts on railway signal system from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In the student reports, they will demonstrate the railway signal system planning and evaluation report for the management, communication and automatic control.

name.zh: 鐵道號誌與行車控制系統
name.en: Railway Signal and Traffic Control System

interdisciplinary: 智慧鐵道微學程
notes: ◎/陸一平(兼任.新聘)/限50人/機械三四甲乙丙合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。基本概念、生產預測、產品/服務設計、生產製程與產能規劃、設施佈置、工作系統設計、生產計劃、生產管制、存貨管理、全面品質管理、設備預防保養。
description.en: Fundamental Concepts, Production Forecasting Product/Service Design, Production Processes and Capacity planning, Facility Layout, Job system Design, Production planning, Production Control, Inventory Control, Total Quality Management, Preventive Maintenance.

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

name.zh: 數位化設計與開發特論
name.en: Special Topics on e-Design and e-Development

description.zh: 先修課程：數位電路與微處理器工業自動化基本控制元件的設計觀念、使用方法與應用規劃；內容包含人機介面裝置(Human Machine Interface, HMI)、可程式邏輯控制器(Programmable Logic Controller, PLC)、交流伺服馬達(AC Servo Motor)的原理解說與應用設計實作課程。
description.en: Pre-requisites：Digital Circuit, MicroprocessorThe fundamental design concepts、operations and application development of industrial automation controllers are focused. Architectures and applications design of Human Machine Interface(HMI), Programmable Logic Controller(PLC) and AC Servo Motor are introduced. Hands-on work and exercises are included.

interdisciplinary: 半導體設備微學程
notes: */限48人/須先修微處理機/機械三甲乙丙合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。1.基礎物理光學2.超音波簡介3.雷射超音波的生成4.雷射超音波的偵測5.刀鋒邊緣技術6.雙頻干涉儀7.費里裴洛干涉儀8.非線性晶體干涉儀9.雷射超音波技術於非破壞檢測之應用10.雷射超音波技術於材料性質量測之應用11.雷射超音波技術發展的未來趨勢
description.en: 1.Introduction to physical optics, 2.Introduction to ultrasonic waves, 3.Optical generation of ultrasound waves, 4.Detection of ultrasonic waves with optical methods, 5.Knife edge technique, 6.Hetrodyne interferometers in LUT, 7.Fabry-Perot interferometers, 8.Two-way mixing interferometers, 9.Application of LUT in nondestructive testing, 10.Application of LUT to material characterizations, 11.Future trend of LUT.

notes: ◎/限21人/機電所和機械自動化班合開

description.zh: 本課程主要探討當前重要教育議題，如:藝術與美感教育、性別教育、人權教育、勞動教育、法治教育、生命教育、品德教育、多元文化教育、新移民教育、原住民教育、媒體素養教育、生涯發展教育、環境教育、藥物教育、性教育、國際教育等各類教育議題。教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en: The course is aimed to provide current issues in education, such as: artistic and aesthetic education, gender education, human rights education, labor education, legal education, life education, moral education, multicultural education, new immigrants education, aboriginal education, media literacy education, career development education, environmental education, drug education , sex education , international education and other education issues.Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

interdisciplinary: 教育學程

description.zh: 複習矩陣及向量、狀態空間描述法、求解狀態空間方程式、可控制性及可觀察性、穩定性分析、狀態變數回饋系統的設計、簡介最佳控制、簡介強健控制。
description.en: Review of matrices and vectors, state space representation of control systems, the solution of the state space equations, controllability and observability, stability analysis, design of state variable feedback systems, optimal control systems, and robust control systems.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001053或負責教授同意。Z-轉換、取樣資料系統、等效於連續函數的數位濾波器設計、使用轉換技術設計數位控制系統、使用狀態空間設計數位控制系統、電腦控制。
description.en: Z-Transform, Sampled-Data Systems, Discrete Equivalents to Continuous Transfer Functions: The Digital Filter, Design of Digital Control Systems Using Transform Techniques, Design of Digital Control Systems Using State-Space Methods, Application and Practice of Digital Control, Case Study.

interdisciplinary: 自動化科技學程

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

interdisciplinary: 生醫材料學程

description.zh: 本課程介紹電子顯微鏡之結構，成像及繞射原理，以及在材料科學方面之應用，課程內容包括穿透式電子顯微鏡之構造，電磁透鏡與成像原理，電子繞射原理，繞射圖型分析，試片之製作方法。掃描式電子顯微鏡之構造及成像原理。EDS及WDS之X光光譜測量。
description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science. The course contents include structure of the transmission electron microscope, the electromagnetic lens and theory of image formation, theory of electronic diffraction, analysis of diffraction pattern, and the preparation of test sample. The structure and principle of forming image for a scanning electron microscope, the X-ray spectrography of EDS and WDS are also included in this course.

interdisciplinary:
半導體科技學程
半導體設備微學程
notes: ◎/限30人/製科所必選課程之一/機電所和製科所合開

description.zh: 講授工程圖之基本原理及規則，並佐以必要之工程設計知識與AutoCAD繪圖技巧,培養學生具備熟練與有效率地將設計構想以工程圖方式正確表達的能力。
description.en: An introductory course providing the student with fundamental information, understanding and skills mainly in orthographic projection. Theories and principles of engineering drawing will be specifically introduced and concurrent with the practice of drafting for industrial design.

description.zh: 掌握形式從屬機能旨意，熟悉施作技術限制與創意可行性，學習從設計到實作的落實，透過各種機械設備操作、加工技術學習，實際接觸及操作真實材料，了解材料種類、性質、加工過程、組裝知識、技術與美學等，以呈現設計作品之原型與成品。
description.en: Based on “Form follows Function”, student will learn interacts and limitations among technology feasibility and creative application, in order to master sequential implementations form design ideas to real works. Students are required to operate various mechanical equipment and processing technologies, thus to realize the types and nature of the materials, processing procedure, as well as the assembly of knowledge, technologies and aesthetics to format intended design prototypes and establishments.

description.zh: 應用設計手繪工具與技法於各種設計作品圖面呈現，培養學生對空間、形體、材質、介面、裝置、比例等簡潔繪畫技巧與圖示性設計圖表達能力。
description.en: Students will learn to sketch by hand in various tools and technologies on design drawings. The simple painting tips as, spatial perceptive, presentation of form and materials, interfaces media types and installations, and proportion as well as abilities of the infographic design presentation will be taught in this class.

description.zh: 讓學生習得3D 材質編修電腦軟體之技能，俾能將工業設計產品進行材質模擬與色彩計劃。
description.en: The study of materials edit computer software which could apply materials simulation and color plan on industrial design products.

description.zh: 應用快速手繪觀念結合數位技術等工具軟體，使設計作品之發表及簡報方式能達到視覺上更豐富而生動的表達效果。
description.en: Teaching student to use digital software to simulate design proposal for a perfect presentation.

description.zh: 設計方法隨著技術演進逐步發展。本課程將介紹從Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) 到 Design for X (DFX) 的設計方法。在創造具有複雜幾何形狀的產品時，3D列印(又稱積體製造additive manufacturing) 是具備潛力的設計工具，特別是對於定制符合人體工程學的設備。本課程將透過專題實作與討論，讓學生探索設計方法對於3D列印的影響。完成本課程後，您將能夠：1.描述設計方法的演變2.討論藝術家、設計師和工程師之間的差異3.了解不同3D列印技術的製程優勢和限制4.分解從藝術到零件的 3D 工作流程5.使用數位設計工具來優化 3D 零件的應用要求
description.en: Design methodologies can evolve with the emergence of advanced technologies. This course will introduce a historical account of design methodologies from Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) to Design for X (DFX). In this regard, additive manufacturing (AM), also known as 3D printing, has great potential for creating products with complex geometric, particularly for custom-fit ergonomic devices. Project-based activities will be carried out for students to explore the effects of good and bad designs for 3D printing.Upon completing this course, you will be able to:1.Describe the evolution of design methodologies2.Discuss the differences between an artist, a designer, and an engineer3.Identify the key advantages and process-specific constraints of AM technology4.Breakdown the 3D workflow from art to part5.Use computational design tools to optimal application requirements for 3D parts

notes: 工設三四與日碩合開，人數上限13

description.zh: 1. 混凝土結構概述與支撐結構混凝土材料特性, 2. 支撐結構設計載重與材料強度規定, 3. 離岸風機地震載重設計, 4. 離岸風機風載重設計, 5. 離岸風機波浪載重設計, 6. 支撐結構之疲勞設計, 7. 支撐結構之鋼結構設計與案例, 8. 支撐結構之混凝土結構設計與案例, 9. 離岸風機基礎設計
description.en: 1. Concepts of concrete structures and concrete material properties, 2. Loads and material strength required for designing supporting structures, 3. Seismic design of offshore wind turbines, 4. Wind resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 5. Wave resistance design of offshore wind turbines, 6. Fatigue design of supporting structures, 7. Case studies of steel structure design for supporting structures, 8. Case studies of concrete structure design for supporting structures, 9. Footing design of offshore wind turbines

name.zh: 離岸風機支撐結構分析與設計
name.en: Analysis and design of supporting structures for offshore wind turbines

interdisciplinary: 離岸風電跨域微學程
notes: 防災所和工程學院(大)合開(限大學部選修20人)

description.zh: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。
description.en: This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

name.en: Special Topics on Advanced Materials Chemistry

interdisciplinary:
先進材料化學微學程
半導體製程微學程

description.zh: 本課程討論，利用儀器分析工作之理論，儀器之原理，構造操作及計算等。包括光譜化學，原子吸收光譜，電漿發射光譜儀，發光光譜儀，電分析化學，PH計，電解沉澱法，伏安法，極譜儀，等儀器之探討。
description.en: This course discusses the theoryof instrumental analysis operation, the principle of instrument, structural operation and calculation. It includes spectrum chemistry, atomic absorption spectrograph, plasma jet spectrograph, light spectrograph, electric analytic chemistry, PH meter, electrolytic precipatation, volt ampere, polar spectrograph, etc..

interdisciplinary:
生醫材料學程
先進材料化學微學程

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

interdisciplinary:
人工智慧與虛擬實境微學程
沉浸式影像創作與展演微學程
元宇宙微學程

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機(大疆/Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用(Open source SDK)、APP開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study. The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

name.zh: 智慧空間互動程式設計
name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

interdisciplinary:

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹行動裝置遊戲設計企劃所需了解之專業知識與技術，並透過設計實務的操作使學生能具備行動裝置遊戲設計企劃的實務能力。課程內容包含行動遊戲個案研究、行動遊戲市場分析、行動平台與技術研究、行動遊戲內容設計、遊戲規則與架構設計、遊戲腳本製作、遊戲情境設定等。教學將以課堂講授、分組討論、設計專案執行等方式進行，並以專題報告繳交與課堂發表為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge of mobile game design planning, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to be equipped with the capability of mobile game design planning. Course contents include mobile game case study, marketing analysis, mobile platform and technologies study, content design, game structure design, script planning and scenario settings. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, group discussion and design project. Students will be evaluated by reports and oral presentation.

name.zh: 行動裝置遊戲設計企劃

description.zh: 本課程將介紹資訊視覺化設計與應用的原理與基礎。課程內容將包括:a) 資訊圖像及數位視覺的深入探討b) 利用電腦程式語言製作分析圖表、空間地圖及介面設計。c) 故事與應用主題的視覺化設計在本課程中，學生將學習如何有效的將資訊轉化為具視覺化美感的圖像，並從不同的案例分析中學會如何評估資訊視覺化設計作品與應用。
description.en: This course is an introduction to the principles and basic of infographic design and application. It consists of following issues:a) The deep study of information graphics and digital visualizations.b) The use of computer program language to create charts, maps and user interface.c) The illustrations design to tell stories and application implementation.In this course, you will learn to create effective and beautiful graphical displays of evidence, and to critically evaluate examples from case studies.

name.zh: 資訊視覺化設計與應用

interdisciplinary:
人工智慧與虛擬實境微學程
人本自然語言處理與互動設計微學程

description.zh: 本課程將教授組織工程技術之基本原理及其應用。課程內容包括幹細胞技術、細胞與組織之物理化學性質、細胞之生長曲線與特性、細胞與組織培養、基因轉殖、細胞與組織分離技術、細胞支架之生醫材料、組織工程產品之檢測，以及組織工程產品上市流程等。
description.en: This course will illustrate the basic principles and applications of tissue engineering technologies. The content is consists of stem cell technologies, properties of cells and tissues, cellular-fate process, cell and tissue culture, gene transfer, cell and tissue separation, biomaterials for scaffold, testing of tissue engineered medical products (TEMPs), and the commercialization process for TEMPs.

description.zh: 先修課程：3002011或負責教授同意。基本觀念及其領域、非線性代數之數值解法、聯立方程式之數值解、多項式內外插、微分、積分、常微分方程、起始與邊界值問題之數值解法。
description.en: 1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the numerical method 2. Numerical methods of solving nonlinear algebraic equations. 3. Numerical methods of solving systems of linear equations. 4. Numerical interpolation and extrapolation. 5. Numerical differentiation and integration.6. Numerical methods of ordinary differential equations with initial-value problems and boundary value problems.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001017或負責教授同意。運動方程式、一維振動（自由及強制）、振動量測、二維振動、多維振動及機械應用說明。
description.en: Equation of Motion, Single-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration (Free and Forced),Measurement of Vibrations, Two-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration, Multiple-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration and its Applications in Mechanical Engineering.

description.zh: 本課程是教導學生金融科技的基本概念，使學生能夠建立金融科技的創新應用。內容包括:金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、P2P 匯兌、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財與期末專題製做。
description.en: This course is to instruct students the basic concepts of financial technology and to enable students to develop innovative applications of financial technology. The contents include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, P2P lending, virtual money, third-party payment, crowd funding, P2P remittance, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory.

description.zh: 本課程在培養同學創業的知識與思維，以及了解營運模式如何應用在商業活動裡。本課程包含: 創業精神的想法和行動、從失敗中學習、設計思考、市場測試、機會衡量、營運模式建立、價值主張、永續經營、企業倫理等議題。
description.en: The course is to encourage students to have the ideas of entrepreneurship and to establish the abilities of running a business. This course is focused on: entrepreneurial thought and action, learning from failure、design thinking、opportunity evaluation、market tests、the development of business model、value propositions、network、sustainable and business ethics.

description.zh: 本課程探討資訊系統在現代組織中所扮演的角色，課程重點將放在企業電子化和電子商務，同學在修課過後將具備相關知識。課堂中的資訊實務技術演練，將有助於同學有效率地解決相關問題。
description.en: This course provides the knowledge you need to understand the role of information systems in modern organizations, with particular focus on E-commerce and E-business. Along with skills learned in your functional area, knowledge from this course will help you effectively use information technology for solving business problems.

description.zh: 學習典範產業的實務經驗，帶給學生產業的思維。以真實具體的研究開發與產業經驗為教材，激發學生追求科技創新成就的渴望，強化青年學子對產業職涯的規劃。
description.en: Through the experience of industrial managers and engineers, we hope students to learn about the practical problems in the industry. By offering different topics and current trends emphasizing on the research and development of various industries, this course wishes to inspire students to pursue their careers in future time.

description.zh: 本課程目標旨在介紹學生軟體工程的概念，並瞭解相關的技術與應用。學生將會學習，開發一個高品質軟體所需要的軟體工程原理、觀念、方法、技術、與步驟。本課程將介紹下列主題：專案流程、專案管理與規劃、.系統需求分析、系統設計方法、系統測試與驗證、系統維護方法等。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a better knowledge and skills in software engineering. In particular, students will learn about the principles, concepts, methods, and techniques of the software engineering approach to producing quality software. The course covers the subjects on software process models, project management and planning, software requirement specifications and analysis models, software design methods, software verification and validation techniques, and software maintenance.

description.zh: 1. 數學基礎 1.1 函數成長率之漸近性質 1.2 遞迴關係之解 1.3 數學歸納法 2. 基本分析技巧 2.1 計算複雜度之上下限2.2 最差情況分析及平均情況分析 2.3 動態平均分析 3. 基本設計技巧 3.1 分擊法 3.2 貪婪法 3.3 動態規劃 3.4 隨機演算法 4. 計算複雜度 4.1 資訊理論證明法 4.2 對抗式證明法 4.3 問題之線性轉換 4.4 完全NP
description.en: 1. Mathematical background 1.1 Asymptotic growth rate of functions 1.2 Solving recurrence relations 1.3 Mathematical induction 2. Basic analysis techniques 2.1 Computational complexities -- lower bounds and upper bounds 2.2 Worst case analysis and average case analysis 2.3 Amortized analysis 3. Basic Design Paradigms 3.1 Divide and conquer 3.2 Greedy methods 3.3 Dynamic programming 3.4 Probabilistic algorithms 4. Computational Complexity 4.1 Information-theoretic arguments 4.2 Adversary arguments 4.3 Linear reduction of problems 4.4 NP-completeness

description.zh: 本課程介紹在數位影像處理領域中會使用到的基本觀念與技術. 數位影像處理有非常多重要的應用, 如: 影像內容改善, 工業檢測, 機器知覺等. 課程內容包括: 1.數位影像處理的基礎 2.影像的轉換 3.影像的加強 4.影像的復原 5.彩色影像的處理6.影像的壓縮 7.影像的分割與特徵抽取 8.影像的表達及描述 9.影像的辨認與解釋
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques used in the field of digital image processing (IP). Digital Image Processing has many important applications, for example, image contents improvement, industrial inspection, machine perception. The outline of this course is: 1.Digital image fundamentals 2.Image transforms 3.Image enhancement 4. Image restoration 5. Color image processing 6. Image compression 7. Image segmentation and feature detection 8. Representation and description 9. Recognition and interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程除了介紹技術的原理之外，更著重在實際資安檢測工具的使用，例如: 網路封包監聽工具 (packet sniffer)、網路稽核紀錄分析 (network audit log analysis)等，在CDX雲端資安攻防平台上實際進行實作分析與演練，讓學生能更了解技術原理的真實應用情境。課程內容包含：●計算機網路回顧●網路封包監聽工具●網路稽核紀錄分析●CDX雲端資安攻防平台介紹●網頁安全●滲透測試●弱點評估及測試工具●入侵偵測工具
description.en: 英文概述English Description This course aims to provide practical training on security tools, such as network packet sniffer, network audit log analysis, etc. Operations on Cyber Defense Exercises (CDX) platform for practical attack/defense exercises are trained in classes. Students can better understand the real application scenarios on information security techniques. Course contents including:●TCP/IP protocols●Packet sniffer●Network audit log analysis●CDX cloud security attack/defense platform●Web security: SQL injection, XSS attack, etc.●Penetration test●Vulnerability assessment and test: port scanning tools●Intrusion detection: snort tools

interdisciplinary: 資訊安全微學程

description.zh: 本課程除了介紹軟體開發架構及安全保護的原理之外，更著重在軟體開發平台的實際操作使用，例如:iOS或Android的開發平台等，並以國網中心所建置的CDX雲端資安攻防平台進行實作分析與演練，讓學生能更了解技術原理的實際應用情境。課程內容包含：軟體開發流程●軟體潛在威脅●惡意軟體偵測 (malware detection)●網頁程式安全 (Web application security)●行動應用軟體安全 (Mobile App security): iOS, Android●App漏洞與弱點 (Vulnerabilities in Apps)●App 安全檢測 (Security testing of Apps): static, dynamic●逆向工程 (reverse engineering)
description.en: 英文概述English Description The course aims to introduce principles of software development architecture and associated security technologies. The course also focuses on discussing security issues of actual operations on software development platforms, such as iOS or Android platforms, etc. Students will use CDX cloud platform to exercise practical analysis regarding security attack and defense events, and students are expected to possess better understand of practical applications of security issues for software development. Course contents including:●Software developing procedure●Potential threats for software development●Malware detection●Web application security●Mobile App security: iOS, Android●Vulnerabilities in Apps●App Security testing: static, dynamic●Reverse engineering

interdisciplinary: 資訊安全微學程

description.zh: 學習敏捷與精實軟體開發方法與敏捷實務作法。本課程將涵蓋下列主題：一、Scrum方法二、終極編程方法三、看板方法四、終極編程核心與配套實務作法五、精實軟體開發實務做法
description.en: Students will learn Agile and Lean software development methods and agile practices. This course will cover the following topics:一、Scrum method二、XP method三、Kanban method四、XP primary and corollary practices五、Lean software development practices

description.zh: 人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧"的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1.搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。
description.en: Artificial intelligence seeks to introduce the elements of intelligence into programs and systems in application domain. Topics will include 1. Searching methods 2. Propositional and Predicate logic 3. Theorem Proving 4. Knowledge-based systems and representation of knowledge 5. Machine learning, 6. Genetic algorithms and evolutionary computing, 7. Intelligent agents.

description.en: Dynamical system representation and Modeling of Mechanical systems, Variational Principles Lagrange equation, Hamiltion Principles, System Analysis, System Identification and Application.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。1. 有限元素分析法之基本觀念2. 利用變分原理建立有限元素模式3. 形狀函數及等參數元素4. 一維問題:桿、桁架、樑及骨架等5. 二維問題:平面應力應變及板殼問題。6. 三維問題:一般實體7. 有限元素分析之計算機程式處理8. 有限元素分析於動態問題之應用9. 相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介
description.en: To introduce the basic principle of the finite element analysis and its application in solving various types of engineering problems.1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc.5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc.6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

description.zh: 產品系統研發的過程漫長，為確保其設計產出貼近市場脈動，具有創新性及競爭力，必須透過大量閱讀、即時掌握新興科技發展趨勢、蒐集分析國際知名實際案例。本課程旨在培養學生對國際趨勢的敏銳度，整合跨領域專業的洞察力，了解不同世代的獨特需求脈絡，如何延伸到產品設計應用與跨國團隊合作，進而發掘有影響力的設計研究議題。
description.en: The ever-changing design trends are influenced by many factors that lead to increasingly complex challenges for people, society and the environment. To keep up with the state-of-the-art research and emerging technologies, designers need to acquire a rich body of knowledge and transfer integrated insights from various disciplines to the new product development. This course focuses on the cultivation of students’ critical thinking ability through analyzing the global design case studies and literature. Students will be asked to take a very active role to contribute to discussions and presentations.

description.zh: 本課程將專注於創新產品與混合實境的設計研究方法，期望透過虛實整合與使用者經驗的核心概念，應用研究方法深入探究設計問題與使用者經驗中的痛點，探討實體端產品設計和虛擬端的服務設計之各種可能性與創新概念整合，進而透過設計方法與軟硬體技術落實創新概念，最終達到設計出符合與滿足使用者在未來生活中的各種設計服務與體驗。
description.en: This course will focus on the design research methods of innovative products and mixed reality. It is expected that through the core concepts of virtual-real integration and user experience, it will apply research methods to deeply explore design problems and pain points in user experience and explore physical product design and virtual reality. We will integrate various possibilities of service design with innovative concepts. Then, we intend to utilize the implemented innovative concept by design methods, software, and hardware technologies to achieve the design services and experiences that meet and satisfy users in future life.

name.zh: 產品與混合實境設計研究(一)
name.en: Product and Mixed Reality Design Research (1)

description.zh: 速寫是最古老、最容易、最快速的溝通方式之一，也是充滿希望的設計師及藝術家必備的絕技。藉由大量的植物寫生，提昇觀察能力並把線條練活，進而建立起掌控「形」的基本信心。接下來的靜物寫生著重整體的構圖關係，利用黑白灰的構圖原理，著眼在傳其「神」而不是傳其「形」。將前階段的單線練習，改作分塊、分面的線群練習。再接下來是人物肖像寫生練習。到此，線條的特質、比例的嚴謹皆要掌控，肖像對象的性別、年齡、特徵以及由內在而外顯的神韻，是畫者所要表達的。
description.en: Sketching is one of the oldest, easiest and quickest methods of communicationand also one of the most important skills a hopeful designer and artist must master.The course begins with a lot of plants sketching that helps to enhance your observation and build up your confidence in mastering forms and shapes in order to make your sketches vivid. Next still life sketching focuses on the composition. You are encouraged to utilize the composition principle of black, white and gray, and emphasize more on the vividness than the form until you get rid of the habit of passive copying of the objects. Then you move from the previous linear sketching practice into facet sketching and then block sketching. At the end of the semester, you will practice human portrait sketching. Until now you should be able to handle not only the characteristics of the line and proportion, but also the gender, age, charm and expression of the model.

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於聯合國17項永續發展目標(SDGs)，根據設計思考法及問題導向學習(Problem-based Learning)的模式，以同理心分析、問題發想與定義、創意發想、雛型發展與驗證評估，透過課堂講授、移地教學及設計思考工作坊之操作，期望培養學生問題解決能力，並藉由創新提案參與相關設計競賽或募資平台。
description.en: This course focuses on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the United Nations. According to the design thinking method, the problem-based learning (Problem-based Learning) model, empathy analysis, problem thinking with definition, creative thinking, Through the operation of classroom lectures, ex-situ teaching, and design thinking workshops, it is expected to cultivate students' problem-solving ability, and participate in relevant design competitions or fund-raising platforms through innovative proposals.

description.zh: 本課程通過理論與實際案例介紹3D創作與空間設計軟體：3DS MAX的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實務案例練習操作，最後透過專題設定進行學生自己的內容創作。課程目的是訓練學生在運用3DS MAX軟體進行3D模型、角色造型、空間和相關物件的建構能力，並接續應用在空間展示的內容設計和表現。
description.en: This course content is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' own creation project. The purpose of the course is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance to space display.

description.zh: 認識英文學術論文的語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討英文報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.

notes: 與光電所合開，博班必修，碩班選修需獲授課老師同意

description.zh: 專題演講或書報討論
description.en: In this course, we will invite speakers from the academia, industry and government to lectures on topics in computer science and information engineering.

notes: 限博士班加選（和碩士班合開）

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究 ，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹密碼學的理論與實際，其主要內容如下：簡介；背景知識；DES保密系統；RSA保密系統；其他公開金匙系統；數位簽章；網路安全
description.en: Principles and practice of cryptography are covered in this course. It contains the following material: Introduction；Background Theory；Data Encryption Standard (DES)；RSA Cryptosystem；Other Public-key Cryptosystems；Digital Signatures；Internet Security

interdisciplinary: 資訊安全微學程

description.zh: 隨著網際網路的成長，網路安全與管理的工作變得重要且複雜，本課程旨在介紹建構一安全網路系統之架構及基礎原理，並教導學生目前被使用的網路安全與管理的標準。內容包括： 1. 資料的加密與解密。2. 常見的網路安全通訊協定。3. 防火牆原理及入侵偵測系統。4. 網路管理架構。5. 常見的網路攻擊模式。
description.en: The course is designed to introduce a model for Internet security and provide an up-to-date survey of current network security and management technology. The program is as follows: 1. Data Encryption and Decryption, 2. Network security protocols, 3. FireWalls and Intrusion Detection System, 4. Management Tools, Systems, and Applications, 5.Network Attacking.

interdisciplinary: 資訊安全微學程

description.zh: 針對學生在建築設計及都市規劃基礎訓練之後，有異於前期以技術性思考，改以都市開發及宏觀政策及微觀個案財務之角度切入建築及都市開發之議題，以輔助學生建立都市開發與都市型態間關連性之整合概念。
description.en: After the technical approaches in urban planning and building design, the financial and political issues are to be taken into consideration in urban affairs. The micro- financial plan in developments and the macro- political issues in housing policy would be introduced to the urban planning practice.

name.en: The housing Development and urban Policy

description.zh: 施工歷史可以被視為了解建築理論的關鍵基礎。按照慣例，建築學院提供建築歷史方面的研究方面，包括建築風格和哲學的發展，或者建築材料和建築技術的最新進展。此外，關於建築的理論辯論也更加關注哲學的討論，而不是物理建築的表現。 但是，建築理論主要討論材料和建築系統的表示。因此，材料的構造方法實際上會極大地影響建築理論的解釋。因此，該課程可以分為兩個部分：首先，將回顧東西方世界的建設歷史以及現代時期。其次，將討論結構論和相對論的爭論。本課程的目的是發展與會學生的能力，使他們能夠回顧自己論點的要點，並運用適當的理論來支持或爭論他們對建築理論的理解。
description.en: Construction history could be considered as the key foundation to understand architectonic theories. Conventionally, architectural academies provide study aspects either in architectural histories in terms of development of architectural style and philosophy or in the latest progress of architectural materials and construction techniques. Moreover, theoretical debates of architecture also pay more attentions to philosophical discussions instead of physical construction presentation. Nevertheless, architectonic theories mainly discuss the presentation of materials and construction systems. Therefore, construction methods of materials in fact affect the interpretation of architectonic theories significantly. As a result, this course can be divided into two sections: firstly the construction history of Eastern and Western worlds as well as modern period of time will be reviewed. Secondly the architectonic and relative theoretic debates will be discussed.

description.zh: 一、 本課程目的在使同學認識與了解台灣傳統建築歷史、文化、技術之精髓所在，進而增進建築設計運用傳統建築思想與素材之能力。二、 講述內容包括台灣史前、原住民、荷西、明鄭、清代與近現代等建築之形成與型態變遷過程。三、 講述方式以幻燈片介紹為主，學期中並安排兩次實地參訪。
description.en: 1. This course is based on the belief that： to recognized and understanding of the historical 、culture and technique in the Taiwan Traditional Architecture. 2. The scope of the course are include the styles and changes in prehistorically period, aboriginal, Dutch colonialist, Ch'ing Dynasty and contemporary Taiwan Traditional Architecture. 3. The methods of the course are slides shows and to visit the historical sites

description.zh: 本課程主要內容為：1.嵌入式智慧計算系統、2.嵌入式影像處理技術、3.影像辨識技術、4.人工智慧辨識技術、5.實境互動界面技術，並整合實務議題之專案開發。
description.en: The course contents include: 1. Embedded Computing Systems; 2. Embedded image processing techniques; 3. Image recognition techniques; 4. Artificial intelligence techniques for image analytics; 5. AR-based interactive systems; 6. Practical Projects

name.zh: 嵌入式智慧影像分析與實境界面
name.en: Embedded Computing Systems for Intelligent Image Analytics and Interactive Systems

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程
notes: 資工所和人工智慧學位學程合開

description.zh: 本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en: The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。

description.zh: 先修課程:負責教授同意基本觀念及其領域、非線性代數之數值解法、聯立方程式之數值解、多項式內外插、微分、積分、常微分方程、起始、邊界值問題之數值解法。
description.en: Fundamental Concepts and Its Scope, Numerical Solution of Nonlinear Algebraic Equations and Sets of Equations, Interpolating Polynomials, Numerical Differentiation and Numerical Integration, Numerical Solution of Ordinary Differential Equations, Numerical Solution of Boundary-ValueProblems and Initial-Value Problems.

notes: 計中電腦教室，車輛三、四合開

description.zh: 本課程著重在奈米材料的合成以及鑑定，包含氣相反應以及溶液相反應。課程核心內容為：(1)各式溶液相合成奈米粉末、中空奈米球以及奈米線(2)氣相反應合成奈米管、奈米線(3)分子轉印技術(4)奈米材料檢測技術
description.en: This course will cover the syntheses and characterization of various nanomaterials. The core lectures include:1. syntheses of nanoparticles, hollow nanospheres and nanowires from solutions2. syntheses of nanowires and nanotubes from the gas phase3. molecular imprinting4. characterization and properties of nanomaterials

interdisciplinary: 奈米科技學程

description.zh: 對無機化合物之結構，化學性質等，利用量子化學，群論及結晶化學等加以探討。以配合天然礦物之形成，產狀，地球化學及環境化學等學科之授課內容。
description.en: The chemical structure and properties of inorganic compounds, which are useful for the following courses: the forming and occurrence of minerals, earth and environmental chemistry, will be discussed by using quantum chemistry, group theory and crystallography.

description.zh: 材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en: Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure, its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure, their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity, electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain , dislocation theory, the formation and growth of nucleus, alloy phase theory, degree of freedom of crystal boundary , nucleation and homogenization of casting product, hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

description.zh: 本課程介紹X射線特性、繞射原理及X射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括X射線之產生，X射線之性質，X射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在X射線繞射方法方面則介紹Laue照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。
description.en: Introduction to the following topics:1. Properties of X-Ray2. Geometry of Crystals3. Principles of X-Ray Diffraction4. Experimental Methods(Diffractometer Measurements, Powder Photographs, and Laue Photographs)5. Applications of X-ray Diffraction on Materials Science(Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)

interdisciplinary: 工程_第二專長【材資系_先進材料工程及應用】

description.zh: 生醫製造是新穎的工程領域，是跨基礎科學與工程製造領域的實用科技，本課程專注於生醫製造方法的需求規範、製造原理的解說以及相關的新興領域的應用。在技術方面，生醫製造技術涉及積層製造技術、生物噴印技術、生醫材料、支架結構設計、細胞培養和動物實驗等相關知識。此課程也會說明斷層掃描影像重建人體模型的流程，支架內部孔隙設計對強度的影響，生物列印機的組裝技巧與規範，FDA對生物列印的規範，人工肉品的細胞培養與製造；另外，在應用於藥物開發方面，生醫製造學目前在再生醫學，藥物和組織工程等領域的應用案例說明，以及未來趨勢的分析與討論。
description.en: Biofabrication is a practical guide to the novel, inherently cross-disciplinary scientific field that focuses on biomanufacturing processes and a related range of emerging technologies. These processes and technologies ultimately further the development of products that may involve living (cells and/or tissues) and nonliving (bio-supportive proteins, scaffolds) components. The course introduces students to cell printing, patterning, assembling, 3D scaffold fabrication, cell/tissue-on-chips as a coherent micro-/nano-fabrication toolkit. Real-world examples illustrate how to apply biofabrication techniques in areas such as regenerative medicine, pharmaceuticals and tissue engineering.

description.zh: 本課程由機械工程的角度出發，結合基礎電化學原理，介紹燃料電池的基本原理及種類，由最新市場發展現況導入，介紹燃料電池的發展歷史及最新現況，同時說明提升燃料電池效率及壽命的關鍵影響因素，結合實作方式深入了解燃料電池特性。
description.en: This course is based on the principle of mechanical engineering and electrochemical theory to introduce the basic principles and types of fuel cells. From the latest development in the global market, the course will introduce the fuel cell history and the latest products of fuel cells. The improvement of fuel cell efficiency and lifetime will be explained through fundamental theory and experiments.

name.en: Principle and application of fuel cell

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋半導體產業趨勢發展、超大型(Giga)半導體工廠廠務系統與先進自動化工廠運作、以及先進半導體製程技術和設備等三大部分。
description.en: This course mainly consists of development trend, Giga FAB, FAB automation, and processing technology and equipment for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

description.zh: 工業4.0智能工廠因為大量使用電腦資訊流進行智慧控制達到產線無人化境地，雲端資料庫技術是智能工廠的核心技術，從智慧排單到網頁控制，達到智能聯網與控制。
description.en: The industry 4.0 intelligent factory uses large amount of information to reach intelligent control without people. Cloud database technology is the core of an intelligent factory, which can reach the intelligent network and control from intelligent production order to website control.

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: 於2009年，ASTM定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對它進行光機電原理說明，並以積層製造系統的應用及系統的研發為主要授課方向。
description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the principle of the additive manufacturing technology in terms of its opto-electro-mechanical-system will be discussed. The application and the system development of additive manufacturing are the major topics of this course.

notes: ◎/限30人/機電所和機械自動化班合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程將深入的討論製程中材料之性質。尤其是在材料行為的理論推導方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：塑性加工、顯微結構、強化機構、破壞力學、潛變與疲勞、材料之熱膨脹、熱傳導、電化學性質、擴散理論、相變化動力學、化學性質、以及材料之熱力學性質。
description.en: The properties of materials in service will be discussed in detail. Special focus will be on the theoretically discussion of the behavior of materials. Topics covered include plastic deformation、strengthening mechanisms、fracture、creep and fatigue、heat capacity、thermal expansion、thermal conductivity、the law of electrolysis、electrolytic conductance and transport, and ionic activity、reversible electrode potentials、Irreversible electrode processes、electrochemical measurements、kinetics of phase transformation、diffusion、kirkendall effect、thermodynamic properties of alloy systems、thermodynamics of surfaces and interfaces

notes: ◎/限21人/機電所、製科所和機械自動化班合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。機構的類型合成與數目合成。創造性機構合成。運動、路徑和函數產生器之尺寸合成。最佳化設計。球面機構及空間機構之介紹。
description.en: Type Synthesis and Number Synthesis of Mechanisms. Creative Mechanism Synthesis.Dimensional Synthesis of Motion, Path, and Function Generators. Optimal Design. Introduction of Spherical Mechanisms and Spatial Mechanisms.

description.en: How to use the national sources in a way to have sustainable development is the main purpose of this study. Improper usage of resources will bring a serious disaster from the natural feed back. Construction should take care of the ecology system and the methods of carefulness would be studied in this course.

interdisciplinary: 生態工法與土木環境學程

description.zh: 地質工程為一新興科學，原來為解決全球變遷等大尺度問題而提出。基本上可以土木及環境工程兩大方面。本課程將從地質背景出發，結合工程問題及其處理對策，提供學生一個整合性的思考及基礎的地質知能。
description.en: Geoengineering is planetary-scale environmental engineering, particularly engineering aimed at counteracting the undesired side effects of other human activities. Geoengineering covers a wide range of engineering disciplines related to geo-materials, such as foundation engineering, slope engineering, tunnelling, rock engineering, engineering geology and geo-environmental engineering. This course interests range from geological to geomorphological concept, to provide a firm fundamental background for the civil engineering and environmental engineering, and to manage and mitigate of natural hazards. Implicit in these pursuits is the stewardship of the earth, and the quest to harvest the most advanced fruits of scientific achievements as tools for our graduates to work with.

interdisciplinary: 房屋結構安全性能評估微學程

description.zh: 環境生態學主要講述基本生態學之原理原則，進而應用於土木建設工程的方式主要內容包含：(1)環境生態系統、(2)生態學之基本法則、(3)質與能傳遞、(4)汙染物對生態之影響、(5)台灣地區之生態保育、(6)工程開發生態系統造成之影響、(7)環境影響評估、(8)交通及營建工程之環境問題、(9)全球環境變遷、(10)環境品質與法規。

description.zh: 由於近年來電腦科技發展迅速，在透過地理資訊系統的幫助下，圖文整合的資料庫型態，已有相當完整成熟的作業方式。本課程將針對地理資訊系統的應用功能方向，分別剖析其主要架構與理論。同時配合相關地理資訊系統軟體，建立學員實作能力。
description.en: Operational and management issues in planning management analysis,locational decision making,and design implementation of GIS.Lab project emphasizes student'sspecialization.

interdisciplinary:
生態工法與土木環境學程

工程數位科技與人工智慧微學程
notes: ◎土木三甲乙合開/限40人/土木館106

description.zh: 本課程的目的在提供修過基本統計課程的學生學習使用電腦軟體輔助進行統計分析的機會。R是目前最普遍使用的開放源碼統計軟體，也是在資料科學界裡，到目前為止最受歡迎的語言，若要挖掘大數據的祕密不可或缺，不但跨平台，而且有許多內建的統計函數、繪圖功能和自己的程式語言，對於幫助學生熟悉統計概念和程式設計，以便將來工作就業和進行研究都有不可或缺的幫助，是一套值得學習的工具軟體。本課程將涵蓋R程式的下載安裝、操作介面、繪圖指令、四則和函數運算、套件和程式開發、資料分析及統計應用等，修課學生需要曾經修過一門統計課程。
description.en: The goal of this course is to teach students how to use the open source software R for statistical analysis. R is currently the most commonly used free, open source, and cross-platform statistical software. It has many statistical functions, graphing tools, and its own programming language. Because of its many potential applications, the familiarity of this software could help students in the pursue of their chosen career paths, whether in industries or academic researches. This course will cover the various aspect of R, including installation, operation, data analysis, and program development. An entry-level statistical course is required before taking this course.

notes: ◎土木三四及防災所合開(大學部上限25人)/土木館106

description.zh: 本課程以講授營建工程之污染公害為主,使學生經由該課目的學習以了解其防治方法與原理,此課程內容包括:1.諸論 2.營建施工的種類及其污染形式3.營建管理的相關法規 4.噪音防治5.逸散性粒狀物防治 6.廢土及廢棄物污染防治7.施工作業的環境測定 8.施工現場的環境管理與環境評核.
description.en: To promote the knowledge of principle for students,the course,Prevention of Public Disaster for Activities,focuses on pollution cintrol in construction area.Contents of the course include:Sources and classification of pollution.Management regulations . Fugitive dust,Soil waste,Measurement of pollutants and Safety management.

interdisciplinary: 綠建築微學程

description.zh: 「企業領導力」是企業經營管理中非常重要元素和指標。我們將由學術理論和商業實務案例中，共同分析和探討企業領導力的管理策略; 並著重於企業價值創新，以培育高教學生具有全球商業開發和經營管理的領導技能。
description.en: The course, Corporate leadership, is offered from a practitioner’s viewpoints on how to deploy the concepts, knowledge, theories and experiences for the development of business leadership practice and to achieve the corporate value creation. In the current market-lead and ubiquitous technology driven world, the Corporate Leadership role is not just the corporate internal management concerning but also needs a broad range of issues, such as cross-cultural knowledge and strategic thinking on business development, communication skills with innovative ideas, and management techniques for the long-term business goals. We will expand the scope and scale of the research related, review articles, complete class projects, and discuss real business cases.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意包括10個數值問題1. 簡單熱傳導2. 穩態圓柱熱傳問題3. 完全展開管流4. 翼片對流展開管流5. 理想流體6. 突然膨脹壓縮流7. 自由對流完全展開流8. 軸對稱流9. 無限反應燃燒流場10. 亂流流場
description.en: Including ten problems1. Simple pure conduction problem2. cylindrical conduction for steady non uniform k3. fully develop duct4. fin conduction convection for fully develop5. ideal flow6. sudden expansion compressible7. Free convective flow for fully develop8. Axial symmetry flow9. Infinitely combustion reaction10. Turbulent flow

notes: ◎/限35人/機電所、機械自動化班和能源車輛外生班合開

description.zh: 「媒介與環境」作為近年逐漸開始發展的學術領域，其論述原點通常可追溯自1960年代，藉由Marshall McLuhan對於媒體（Media）與媒介（Medium）的哲學性討論與實驗性創作，首先打開後世電影與媒體學者對於相關學術主題的探討。但這個概念卻要一直到近年，伴隨著科技的進步與媒體研究的發展，例如Anne Friedberg針對當代可以出現在各種人造與非人造環境中的螢幕（Screen）的分析，才被廣泛地作為媒介（Medium）與環境（environment）研究仰賴的分析架構，並奠定後續此學術領域的發展方向。此課程將於都市文化研究的固有知識基礎上，引入媒介與環境領域的新興論述，探究各類「觸媒」對於當代文化發展與都市設計的影響。探討子題包含有數位全球化、文創嘉年華、智慧城市、網飛經濟等當前重要都市發展議題，並透過課堂討論、方法學作業，與期末短論培養學生連結理論與實務、深度反思、和獨立探索新興學術領域的能力。
description.en: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges and scholars in film and media have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. Because of these, the studies of medium and environment has recently been an emerging field that intends to examine the phenomena intertwining the two aspects through interdisciplinary approach. Based on this background, this course will introduce cutting-edge scholarships of medium and environment studies to the traditional field of urban cultural studies, pursuing effective perspectives to unfold today’s critical urban issues, for instance globalization in digital era, carnival and creative industry, smart city, Netflix economy (Harvey, 2020), and so forth. Student will be expected to learn how to bridge theories an

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用科學與系統化的方式解決管理上的問題。整個過程包括：資料蒐集與問題分析、數量模式的建構、問題求解、成本效益分析、系統規劃設計與執行等步驟。課程內容主要以應用案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，也會介紹最佳化計算軟體來求解數學模式並輔助說明所得數據之意涵。
description.en: The purpose of this course is talking about how to utilize scientific and systematical approaches to solve management problems. The solution process includes data collection and problem investigation, model formulation, optimal solution derivation, cost and efficiency analysis, system implementation and execution etc. This course mainly contains various application cases. Accordingly, participant can understand how to apply theoretical methods on solving real problems. Computational software is also utilized to solve the formulated models and analyze and interpret the obtained solutions.

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於幫助學生瞭解財務決策的理論架構，主要著重於介紹財務管理的基本原理，以及其如何運用在財務經理所面對的主要決策上。希望學生於修習本課程後，能瞭解各種財務管理的工具，並能有效率地使用於投資與融資決策上。
description.en: This course is to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. The focus is on setting out the basic principles of financial management and applying them to the main decisions faced by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.

description.zh: 隨著人類對於工程技術的省思，以及環境倫理的變遷，兼顧生態、安全、景觀等面向生態工法逐漸受到重視。我國自2002年起，全力推動生態工法的落實及應用上的困難。有鑑於此，特開立「生態工法概論」，建立全盤性的了解，使土木工程能迎合時代的需求，提升相關智識水準。因此，將分別就基本精神、案例、應用範疇等議題進行探討。
description.en: This is intended as brief introduction to the subject of Ecological Engineering Methods(EEM), which is a whole new concept in the field of civil engineering. The Advantages of EEM is not only to satisfy the demand of safety(i.e. natural hazards control)but also that of protecting ecosystem and landscape aesthetic. In 2002, related government agencies try to pormote the application of EEM , and attempt to adopt this specific measure. However, the lack of basic understanding and knowledge has been the main reason why engineers are struggling in introducing EEM into reality. Therefore, including fundamental theories, cases study, and practical apects of application will be taught in this course. The optimal goal is to inspire students to learn more about new philosopgy and techniques in the world of civil engineering.

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

description.zh: 認識坡地災害，包括全球性的原因與台灣地區特有的自然因素、人為因素及坡地災害現，進而討論坡地災害防治的原則及方法。1.坡地災害防治的重要性 2.坡地災害的全球性原因 3.台灣的削平速率與山坡地崩坍概況 4.台灣地區最脆弱的坡地 5.台灣地區坡地災害的自然動力 6.坡地災害的人為因素 7.坡地破壞之前兆 8.坡地災害防治一般性原則 9.坡地災害防治所必需的基本資料 10.坡地災害的防治與復育技術 11.坡地災害的緊急救治方法 12坡地災害個案分析
description.en: Slope calamity preventionTo understand slope -suffering, include global factors and specific nature factors, man-made factors and current slope-suffering in Taiwan to discuss the slope calamity prevention's method and principles.1.the importance of slope calamity prevention2.the global factors of slope calamity prevention3.the cut velocity and slope slide overview4.the frailest slope in Taiwan5.the nature factor in Taiwan slope calamity6.the man-made factor in slope calamity7.the omen of slope damage8.the general principles in slope calamity prevention9.essential basic information of slope calamity prevention10.slope calamity prevention and repair skill11.the emergency treatment in slope calamity prevention12.slope calamity case analyses

description.zh: 政府近年積極推動行政資訊化，應用資訊技術提昇行政的效率與品質，以達到便民及創新的效益。地理資訊系統(Geographical Information System，簡稱GIs)之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位在處理大量圖籍與相關文字資料之管理與查詢的最佳解決方案；配合完整中文介面與印表技術，更可提高效率資訊服務。國內各重大工程在規劃設計時，正逐漸引用地理資訊系統。以其強大之資訊處理、整合、分析、及展示等功能輔助，如圖籍疊合與環框分析等，使工程規劃設計更為準確客觀，發揮工程最大效益。
description.en: To provide public service with better quality, the administration of government with information-based is widely established by adopting newly developed information technology. Geographic Information System is one of the technology especially applicable when massive maps and attribute data are involved in management affairs. It offers users a solution for information management and data query under a graphic environment with Chinese interface as well as output printing specification. The planning and design of major construction projects in Taiwan were increasingly referred to GIS for the reason that efficiency can be maximized by the powerful data organization, integration, and display capability along with GIS.

name.en: Special Topics on Geographical Information System

description.zh: 本課程係以營建工程專案管理之架構為核心目標，說明營建專案管理介紹，應用及方法論介紹，專案管理研究方法、透過營建管理重要課題，藉由工程實務經驗，使修課同學得以瞭解抽象的管理理念，而後能實際加以運用。內容範圍包含專案管理研究方法、品質管理，風險管理，價值工程，生產力分析，合約管理，糾紛與談判等營建工程專案管理等理論或實務內容。

description.zh: 本課程主要針對營建管理領域重要課題以及營建時事進行分析探討，透過課題分析、報告以及討論，增進學生對於營建管理領域相關課題之了解及認知，進而思考日後可能面對的類似課題。

By the subjects analysis, reports and discussion, students can improve their abilities of understanding the construction management domain, and thinking of similar subjects they may have later.

description.zh: 妥善地利用資源可促使資源生生不息，不當地濫用卻會帶來大地反撲，禍及人類，如何在建設的同時,大興土木之際，顧及生態體系，及為本課程之主要重點。課程內容包括環境生態系統、生態學之基本法則、質能傳遞、污染物對生態之影響。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to learn how to use the natural sources for industrial development but alse maintain the ecological balance. Improper usage of natural resourses will bring adverse results. The topic will include:fundamental ecology, mass and energy transfer and the impact of industrial development on ecology.

description.zh: 應用統計學之目的乃教導學生機率與統計的理論，其強調利用統計方法及資料分析之技巧，以解決工程上可能面臨的問題，因此本課程將大量引用真實資料及實例，以說明如何處理相關的問題。本課程的包含的內容將涵蓋資料分析、機率、隨機變數、機率分佈、推估、假設檢定、取樣、線性迴歸、機率過程、變異數分析及多變量分析。
description.en: This is a comprehensive course in probability and statistics for students in engineering and technology discipline. It emphasizes modern statistical methods and data analysis using real data and examples to offer students exposure to practical applications. This course will provide an opportunity to learn how probabilistic analysis and statistical reasoning and testing can be applied to a wide range of problems in civil engineering. Topics to be covered will include data analysis, probability, random variables, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, sampling, linear regression, statistical process control and analysis of variance.

description.zh: 本課程將探討明渠中穩定流、非穩定流、均勻流、非均勻流之流體特性。
description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure. The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied). For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

description.zh: 認識科技文章及科技學術論文語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討技術報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on technology and technical writings are concerned. Discussions include specific ways to technical presentation and technical writings.

description.zh: 行銷英文是為商業人士及學習商業英語的學生而安排的一種多位階的商業英文課程。課程教本已經與世界領先企業資源之一的美國"經濟時代"期刊合作完成。課程單元都是為了讓學生具備好的工具和應用技巧以便他們可以在國際企業和行銷上有成功的表現而設計。課程結束後，學生將有能力在全面的商業環境下用英文去充分的溝通;能夠在商業的世界中去發揮他們的知識，更流利而且有自信的運用商業語言，進而增加他們服務公司的繁榮與發展。
description.en: Marketing English is a multi-level business English course for businesspeople and students of business English. The course book has been developed in association with the Financial Times, one of the leading sources of business information in the world. The units are designed to equip students with the tools and skills they need to succeed in marketing and international business. At the end of this course, students will be able to communicate in English in a wide range of business situations; they will also enlarge their knowledge of the business world; and they will be more fluent and confident in using the language of business and should increase their companies’ prospects.
